## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: positive sector breadth but a major divergence among large-cap Tech (NVDA, MSFT, META showing 1W/1M disagreement) and concentrated leadership in the Top 5 (Leadership: Narrow — 3/5 Technology), supporting a neutral, transitional market.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +3.35%) ABOVE TREND and PSX (1W: +8.19% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND, with CVX (1W: +2.93% | 1M: -3.43%) in RECOVERY. Consumer Staples strong: MO (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing leadership pockets: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Materials weak: FCX (1W: -7.37% | 1M: -7.39%) BELOW TREND and NEM (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary mixed with booking names off: BKNG (1W: -5.89% | 1M: +1.34%) CORRECTION. Healthcare showing weakness: ISRG (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%) BELOW TREND and SYK (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, MO (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND, GD (1W: +10.42% | 1M: -0.88%) RECOVERY; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: NVDA (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION, ISRG (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -5.52% | 1M: +0.86%) CORRECTION, SHW (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -5.89% | 1M: +1.34%) CORRECTION; weakness concentrated in Tech and Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Best 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND; watch the megacap divergences in NVDA (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION and META (1W: -9.82% | 1M: +5.10%) CORRECTION for momentum fade.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed with early CORRECTION patterns among megacaps. AAPL (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +9.59%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND contrast with NVDA (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION and MSFT (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +12.20%) CORRECTION, indicating internal rotation; sector 1W +1.83% (24 stocks).

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials showing steady strength and breadth support. JPM (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +6.33%) ABOVE TREND and V (1W: +6.01% | 1M: +9.89%) ABOVE TREND lead while MA (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +0.95%) sits in CORRECTION, suggesting selective strength; sector 1W +1.48% (20 stocks).

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare is lagging with mixed news catalysts. LLY (1W: +8.98% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +34.60%) ABOVE TREND are pockets of strength but ISRG (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -1.44%) BELOW TREND and SYK (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -10.53%) BELOW TREND weigh on the sector; sector 1W -0.34% (17 stocks).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Financials, Energy and select Consumer Staples exposure given breadth and 1W leadership pockets; reduce exposure to high-multiple Tech names showing CORRECTION (NVDA, MSFT, META) until 1W/1M alignment resumes. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective and monitor megacap tech divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +18.92% | 1M: +39.07%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +8.98% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -4.72% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -9.82% | 1M: +5.10%) CORRECTION, SHW (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +0.64%) and Financials (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +6.97%) for follow-through. BEARISH: Materials (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +2.52%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.11% | 1M: +3.06%) for continued weakness and dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA: track ability to erase this week’s 1W loss and reclaim short-term momentum to exit CORRECTION; GOOGL: sustained follow-through on large 1W gain to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; INTC: confirmation of ABOVE TREND requires follow-through next week after the big 1W surge; LLY: watch for sentiment-fueled continuation post-earnings beat.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
GD (+80): GD (1W: +10.42% | 1M: -0.88%) RECOVERY — bullish guidance news confirming the 1W move. LLY (+60): LLY (1W: +8.98% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND — earnings beat and analyst lifts confirming price action. CVX (+60): CVX (1W: +2.93% | 1M: -3.43%) RECOVERY — Q1 beat supports tactical recovery despite 1M lag.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
SHW (-50): SHW (1W: -5.83% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND — negative commentary confirming price weakness. AAPL (-45): AAPL (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +9.59%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines diverge from price, flagging distribution risk to monitor closely.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. GOOGL (1W: +11.99% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.69% | 1M: +107.41%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +8.98% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major megacap Tech divergence (NVDA, MSFT, META in CORRECTION) and some negative headlines (AAPL) create tactical distribution risk to monitor.
